About MDOTM

MDOTM is a global leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, growing across our offices in London, Milan, and New York. We recently closed a $27M growth equity round, led by Expedition Growth Capital, to support our continued international expansion. Our proprietary platform, Sphere, currently supports over $100B in assets under management for institutional clients including Morgan Stanley, Amundi, and Zurich Bank.
Role Overview
MDOTM, a leading provider of AI-driven investment solutions, is looking for an Intermediate DevOps Engineer to join our Platform Team. You will play a key role in supporting, enhancing, and maintaining the foundational infrastructure and tools that empower our product teams — contributing to a reliable, scalable, and efficient developer platform that enables fast and secure software delivery for Sphere, our proprietary AI-driven investment platform.
Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and automation of CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD) to ensure fast, safe, and repeatable releases across all environments.

• Assist in the adoption and management of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Ansible, helping provision and manage on-premise and AWS resources in a controlled, auditable, and reproducible manner.

• Work with Docker and Kubernetes to package and operate services, contributing to declarative configuration, GitOps practices, and efficient resource utilization.

• Help implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and tracing solutions (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Zabbix), and participate in on-call rotations to ensure high availability and low Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR).

• Contribute to embedding security best practices (OWASP Top 10, least privilege IAM, shift-left testing) into the SDLC and help automate security controls within pipelines.

• Support the management and automation of database infrastructure (MySQL, MongoDB), including provisioning, backups, and automated schema migrations.

• Automate and support the deployment, scaling, and operational health of core platform services (authentication, data pipelines, messaging) for internal consumers.

• Participate in technical design discussions, learn from architectural decisions related to infrastructure and operations, and help document runbooks and standards.

• Champion DevOps culture ("you build it, you run it") and share knowledge through demos, pair programming, and internal workshops.

Skills Required

• 1–3 years of professional experience in a DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) role, with a focus on automation, infrastructure, and CI/CD

• Hands-on experience working with and contributing to CI/CD pipelines

• Practical experience with Docker and exposure to Kubernetes, including writing Dockerfiles and debugging containerized applications

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible

• Experience with at least one monitoring, logging, or alerting system (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Zabbix), and curiosity for SRE principles

• Proficiency in at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating common tasks

• Basic understanding of security best practices in the SDLC

• Good analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting system and infrastructure issues

• Clear English communication, collaborative spirit, and a growth mindset aligned with a culture of shared ownership and rapid feedback

Bonus points:

• Experience with event-driven systems (e.g., ActiveMQ)

• Contributions to open-source projects

• Familiarity with backend development concepts (e.g., Java/Spring Boot)

• Working knowledge of AWS fundamentals (EC2, S3, IAM)

• Financial-services or high-throughput data processing background

Why Join Us?

• Work at the leading edge of technology, leveraging our decade of experience in proprietary AI to power a platform trusted by top-tier institutional clients.

• Truly flexible work environment — we care about output, not hours logged.

• Collaborate daily with an ultra-international team (18+ nationalities) across our Milan, London, and New York offices.

• Annual company retreat at a stunning location, because we invest in our people beyond the day job.

• Real, fast-track career progression, with outsized growth opportunities for early team members.

About ixigo:

Launched in 2007 by Aloke Bajpai & Rajnish Kumar, ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited) is a technology company focused on empowering Indian travellers to plan, book and manage their trips across rail, air, buses and hotels. ixigo assists travellers in making smarter travel decisions by leveraging artificial intelligence. The ixigo, ConfirmTkt and AbhiBus apps allow travellers to book train tickets, flight tickets, bus tickets, hotels, and cabs, and provide travel utility tools and services developed using in-house proprietary algorithms and crowd-sourced information. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in Fiscal 2025, ixigo is the leading OTA for Next Billion Users in India. For more information, please visit http://www.ixigo.com

About the Role:
As a Product Manager - Flights at ixigo, you will work on the end-to-end flights product, driving growth across the booking funnel while ensuring a reliable, trustworthy experience across the customer journey.
You will balance user experience, business growth, and operational efficiency across a high-volume, high-stakes product area.

Responsibilities:
• Flights Product Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for the flights business, balancing growth, conversion, and customer experience priorities across the funnel
• Post-Booking Experience: Own key post-booking journeys including cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds, working with CX teams to identify and resolve recurring customer pain points
• Booking Funnel Optimization: Own and continuously improve the search-to-book funnel, search relevance, seat/meal selection, add-ons — to reduce drop-offs and improve conversion at every step
• Partner Onboarding & Distribution: Lead the onboarding of new airlines, GDS/NDC partners, and supply sources to expand flight inventory. Additionally, own the B2B API distribution charter — onboarding partners who wish to integrate our flight APIs to sell flights on their own platforms, defining API/product requirements, and ensuring smooth technical and commercial integration for these partners
• Continuous Experimentation: Champion A/B testing across search, discounting, and checkout flows to systematically improve conversion and revenue metrics
• Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the central node between Design, Backend, Frontend, Analytics, and the AI/ML teams. You will translate complex business needs into PRDs and user-centric designs
• Data-Driven Optimization: Define and track North Star metrics such as funnel conversion rate, supply coverage, partner integration TAT, and customer satisfaction, using these insights to guide roadmap decisions

Qualifications:
• 4-6 years of experience in Product Management, ideally within a high-growth B2C tech company, OTA, or travel-tech setting. Experience with funnel optimization, marketplace/supply growth, or partner integrations is a strong plus
• Funnel & Growth Mindset: Strong understanding of conversion funnels and the ability to identify and prioritize high-impact optimizations across search, pricing, and checkout
• User-Centric Mindset: An eye for great UX/UI and a solid understanding of the end-to-end travel booking experience, including post-booking needs
• Technical Fluency: Comfortable discussing API/integration structures with backend teams and airline/GDS systems
• Execution Excellence: Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and ship reliable, high-quality features in an agile environment

Additional (Preferred):
• OTA Experience: Familiarity with the nuances of the Indian travel market and seasonal booking patterns
• Partnership & Integration Acumen: Comfort working with airline/GDS/NDC partners and translating commercial and technical integration requirements into a clear onboarding roadmap
• AI/ML Exposure: Direct experience working with data science teams to deploy machine learning models
• Growth Mindset: A "hacker" mentality—constantly looking for small tweaks that lead to outsized gains in conversion

Additional Information: Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.
